name: FlxWoo
author: rickey29

sections.description:
FlxWoo is a unique headless WooCommerce integration that keeps all the power of WooCommerce’s core features — without reinventing checkout, cart, payments, or plugin compatibility.

Instead of bypassing WooCommerce’s logic, FlxWoo lets WordPress and WooCommerce execute normally (including all hooks and filters), and then replaces the final HTML output with a headless page rendered by your external Express.js server.

This design offers the flexibility of modern frontend development while keeping full compatibility with WooCommerce extensions, payment gateways, and plugins — and includes a built-in fallback mechanism in case the headless server is unavailable.

Use FlxWoo if you want to build fast, modern, customizable storefronts without breaking WooCommerce’s ecosystem.

Visit my website for more information: https://flxwoo.com/

sections.installation:
1. Install CoCart plugin.
  2. Install the plugin through WordPress plugins screen, or upload the plugin files to WordPress ‘/wp-content/plugins/flx-woo’ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through WordPress plugins screen.
  4. Create WooCommerce REST API keys (Consumer key and Consumer secret):
    WooCommerce -> Settings -> Advanced -> REST API -> Add key or Create an API Key.
    The Permissions setting should be “Read/Write”.
  5. Input the above Consumer key and Consumer secret into FlxWoo Settings section REST API tab and save.
